name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.Hom.map_coordRetract
summary: Write y = Σ a_j v_j with v_j ∈ kisinLoc(L); then y' = Σ a_j F(v_j) with F(v_j) ∈ kisinLoc(L'), and both sides are Σ λ₀(a_j)F(v_j).

steps.claim: y = Σ_j a_j·v_j with v_j ∈ kisinLoc(L) (y is in the span of kisinLoc, span_kisinLoc).
steps.lean: have ⟨_, a, v, e₁⟩ := mem_span_set'.1 (span_kisinLoc.ge y.2)

steps.claim: By coordRetract_sum on both sides (F.wittMap(v_j) ∈ kisinLoc(L'), Hom.wittMap_mem_kisinLoc), both equal Σ_j λ₀(a_j)·F.wittMap(v_j).
steps.lean:
by simp [coordRetract_sum _ e₁, ← e, ← e₁,
    coordRetract_sum (a := a) (F.wittMap_mem_kisinLoc <| v · |>.2)]
